The 37 edges of P3×P8 form twenty involution edge orbits (17 pairs and 3 singleton seam edges). Independently checked all 190 pairs of orbit conflicts against the matching complex of the 3×4 grid with three boundary leaves: exact pairwise compatibility, hence all simplices, is preserved. Independently enumerated 2,636 augmented matching faces of this 20-edge graph with face counts (20,149,524,911,750,255,26). Reconstructed the stated 1316 acyclic toggle pairs and full Hasse topological sort, leaving precisely four critical five-edge faces after pairing augmented empty face. Ordinary Morse model has one 0-cell and four 4-cells and no intervening cells; hence wedge^4 S4. This is an actual geometric fixed set, not invariant homology.
